reroute_hint: The route becomes a blue line with support points where it turns. Drag the line or a point onto other ways: only the stretch between the neighbouring points is routed again, and the drop takes it at once.

match.input=touch: Tap the start of the stretch on the map.
match.input=*: Click the start of the stretch on the map.

match.input=touch: Tap the end of the stretch. Drag a point to move it.
match.input=*: Click the end of the stretch. Drag a point to move it.

match.input=touch: Drag a point to move it. A new tap sets the end again.
match.input=*: Drag a point to move it. A new click sets the end again.

match.input=touch: No way of this route is near one of the points. Tap closer to the route.
match.input=*: No way of this route is near one of the points. Click closer to the route.

reroute_touched: Other relations that gain a part: {count}
reroute_review: To check: {count} points are far from the new path
reroute_roles_hint: Forward: the route follows the way in its direction.
reroute_start_not_routable: The start is not on a road or path this route may use, within 200 m.
reroute_end_not_routable: The end is not on a road or path this route may use, within 200 m.
reroute_no_path: No way joins the two points on the loaded map. The ways may not share a node where they meet (a cycleway that is not joined to the road), a one-way or a turn restriction may block the way, or the area is not loaded.
reroute_limit: The search gave up. Move the points closer together.
reroute_occurrence_title: The stretch occurs more than once in this route. Pick the one you mean.
reroute_refusal_no_route: The router found no route between the two points.
reroute_refusal_same_place: The start and the end are the same place. Put the end on another point.
reroute_refusal_relation: This relation cannot be rerouted: it is not loaded, or it is not a route with a profile Maid can route.
reroute_refusal_bad_stretch: The points do not mark a run of ways of this route. Pick the start and the end again.
reroute_refusal_relation_changed: The members of the route changed since the preview. Pick the points again.
reroute_refusal_read_only: A way of this route, or the route itself, is read-only with the current filters. Nothing was changed.
reroute_refusal_way_not_loaded: A way the route needs is not loaded. Load the area, then pick the points again.
reroute_refusal_closed_way_split: The new path would split a closed way (an area). Move the point off it.
reroute_refusal_split_way_used_outside: The new path would split a way that the route also uses outside the stretch. Nothing was changed.
reroute_refusal_split_not_resolved: The new path could not be placed on the ways. Move the points and try again.
reroute_refusal_route_changed: The ways of the route changed since the preview. Pick the points again.
reroute_refusal_internal: The reroute could not be planned. Nothing was changed.
reroute_reason_sidewalk: A sidewalk: the data splits between empty and forward here.
reroute_reason_sidepath: A sidepath without a one-way tag.
reroute_reason_cycleway_on_road: Cycleway tags on a road: the data splits between empty and forward here.
reroute_reason_not_routed: The bicycle profile does not route this way.
reroute_reason_against_order: The route runs against the node order of a one-way way: forward would be wrong.
reroute_reason_one_way_backward: The way is one-way against its node order (oneway=-1): backward is almost unused in the data.
reroute_reason_loop: The route loops or runs twice over this way.

match.input=touch: Drag the blue line or a support point onto other ways. Only the stretch between the neighbouring points changes, and letting go takes it at once (one undo step).
match.input=*: Drag the blue line or a support point onto other ways. Only the stretch between the neighbouring points changes, and letting go takes it at once (one undo step). Escape ends.

reroute_unchanged: Nothing changes yet: drag the line onto another way.
reroute_section_running: The reroute is under way on the map.

match.input=touch: Or long-tap a way of the route and choose “Reroute the route”: the stretch starts on that way.
match.input=*: Or right click a way of the route and choose “Reroute the route”: the stretch starts on that way.
